CWE-416 — Use After Free
Description: A pointer is used or freed again after the memory it points to has already been freed.
Vulnerability indicators:
- The pointer is not cleared after free and is reused on a later path
- Multiple error paths free the same resource (double free)
- References to an object kept in other structures after it is freed
Safe patterns:
- Pointer set to NULL right after free and checked before use
- Memory ownership with a single release point (goto cleanup)
